description: Normative reference vectors of delsk.oracle-contract.v4 (contract-v4.md section 1): T4(registry-vectors-v3.json), R01-R25 and PM01-PM20 with the v3 outcomes. Synthetic only: no natural corpus, no real registry. Genesis g1_freeze_sha256 is synthetic; the test core does not check it (production does). Expected records are test records (authority null, TEST_ONLY_PASS for SCIENTIFIC_PASS).
